Commentary.Commentary: We've come to the end of this exciting encounter. Both teams leave this game with contrasting fates - Pakistan win their 6th match on the trot in ODIs while Sri Lanka lose their 9th in a row. One on the up, the other on a spiral in the other direction. Some positives from this match for the Lankans, but plenty more to work on. And they must rather quickly. The 3rd ODI takes place at this same venue on 18th October at 1500 local (1100 GMT). Do join us for all the action. Till then, cheers!

On shouting at his players, Sarfraz Ahmed replies that his boys understand him and such was the match situation. Smiles and says that he apologizes later. Admits that the batting flopped and credits Shadab Khan and Babar Azam for their partnership. Showers praise on all his bowlers. He is confident that Azam will come good in Test cricket as well. Feels that batting second ain't easy as the pitch slows down in the second half and hence in spite of all the dew, bowling second was a good call. Further adds that they will see the conditions for the next match and decide whether to bat first or second.

Upul Tharanga says his bowlers bowled really well to keep Pakistan to 219. States had they hung in there they could have done it. Credits the seam bowlers for bowling really well and also applauds Akila Dananjaya and Jeffrey Vandersay for their performances with the ball. Is just disappointed not to win. Mentions Vandersay batted really well to support him, but it was a tough task. On being the only Sri Lankan to carry his bat through in an ODI, with a melancholy in his voice he says it's a good moment for him, but is disappointed to lose the game.

Shadab Khan receives the Man of the Match award for his all-round contribution. He is all smiles and says that he wanted to perform with the bat and help the team. Adds that the plan was to play the full quota of 50 overs. Also praises his bowling partners and says that they were confident of winning. Aims to be the Player of the Series and feels that his captain uses him as per the situation.

With a target then of 220, Sri Lanka suffered a similar fate as the hosts. Reduced to 93/7, with Shadab Khan's 3-fer leading the attack and almost everyone chipping in with wickets, all hope seemed lost. But, captain Upul Tharanga led from the front and took the game deep. He had more than his fair share of luck, was dropped twice, but he still had to make the most of it and he almost did. His partnership of 76 with Jeffrey Vandersay brought some life back into the game, and the skipper completed his hundred as well, but the Islanders eventually fell short when the partnership was broken. Upul Tharanga remained not out throughout the innings, and with that, became the first Sri Lankan to carry his bat through in an ODI. A bittersweet feeling for him, more bitter than sweet surely. He'll feel hard done that he couldn't get his team over the line. Stay tuned for the presentation coming up...

What should have been a one-sided contest, ironically, for both sides at one stage, turned into a real crackerjack of a contest! At the beginning, when Pakistan opted to bat first, they suffered a major collapse courtesy Lahiru Gamage's outstanding 4-wicket haul and it seemed like Sri Lanka would wrap them up rather quickly. But Babar Azam, along with Shadab Khan, shored things up and somehow enabled Pakistan to see the entire 50-over quota out. The former scored a mature, skillful ton while the latter stroked a mature fifty. The 109-run stand gave a fighting platform for Pakistan to battle on.

OUT! Gamage is run out and it's all over for Sri Lanka. Full toss outside off, Lahiru whacks it square of the wicket on the off side and attempts for the second run. The fielder from the deep fires in a direct hit at the striker's end as Gamage tries to dive back in. The keeper appeals and the square leg umpire goes upstairs. The replays roll in and Gamage is nowhere in the frame. But there is some confusion. Sarfraz seems to have disturbed the stumps with his gloves. The third umpire wants to be 100 percent sure here. He watches multiple replays and then finds that the bails didn't come off when Sarfraz made contact with the stumps. Other than that, it was a pretty straightforward decision. OUT flashes on the giant screen and PAKISTAN WIN BY 32 RUNS!
Direct hit at the striker's end! Could be that Sarfraz knocked the stumps with his gloves before the ball crashed into the stumps. Can't tell in real time. Going to have to wait for the replays.
Spears in a full ball on middle, Tharanga makes room and drives it to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Tharanga is refusing to give up! Short in length outside off, Upul camps back and smashes it over extra cover for a boundary. It's not over yet. 35 needed off 14 balls.
Too full in length outside off, Tharanga makes room and squeezes it behind point for a couple of runs.
That's a cracker. Hasan nails in a yorker on off, Tharanga can only dig it out to the off side.
Short in length and outside off, Tharanga makes room and lifts it over mid off for a couple of runs.
Hasan Ali is back on.
Gamage has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Almost a great catch by Junaid! A clever slower delivery by Raees, Tharanga is early into the pull shot and as a result gets a top edge. It balloons in the air, Khan runs forward from short fine leg and attempts to catch it with a dive. But it falls just short. They cross for a run.

Appeal for a catch! Not given by the umpire. A little short in length and angling down the leg side, Tharanga swings and misses. There is some deflection as it goes to the keeper and they appeal. The umpire remains unmoved. Maybe, it went off the thigh pad.
Works it in the gap at mid-wicket and takes a single.
Slants in a length ball on middle, from around the wicket, Gamage defends it from his pads to the leg side.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Tharanga plays a pull shot, doesn't middle it well but it has gone in the gap at square leg for a single.
Short and on middle, pulled down to long on for a run.
Taps a length ball to covers and looks for a run. He is sent back and the fielder has an unnecessary shy at the striker's end. Misses and now they cross. Sarfraz is livid!
Angling away from the batsman, Gamage drives it off his front foot to point.
Lahiru Gamage is the last batsman.

OUT! Lakmal is run out! Back of a length delivery on middle, Tharanga works it in front of square leg and takes a single. Lakmal turns for the second run but is sent back. In the meanwhile, an accurate throw comes in from the deep by Shehzad and Sarfraz does the rest. Lakmal is short of the crease. Sri Lanka lose another wicket.  Poor Tharanga, cannot even celebrate his 15th ODI ton. Bittersweet feeling. What a knock from him but he is running out of partners. Only one left and 48 more to win.

Junaid changes his angle and runs in from around the wicket. He slants in a sharp length ball on middle and leg, Lakmal swings his bat and gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls on the leg side and they steal a run.
Full in length and outside off, Tharanga plays a crisp cover drive for a single.
Junaid Khan returns.
Fuller length ball on middle, it's flicked on the leg side where the mid-wicket fielder makes the stop. Successful over for Pakistan.
Suranga Lakmal next in.

OUT! Raees breaks the threatening partnership. He digs in a short ball around leg, 119 kph, rising onto the batsman who attempts to pull it into the stands. Fails to make proper connection and Shehzad at deep square leg makes no mistake. The change in pace did the trick for Rumman, allowed no pace to work with and Vandersay failed to generate enough power on his own. 51 needed from 31 balls.
Slower shorter ball on off, Tharanga pulls it through square leg for another single.
On a length and around leg, Vandersay comfortably works it behind square leg and takes a single.
Short and outside off, slower in pace, Tharanga lofts it down to third man and takes a single.
Fullish and outside off, Tharanga drives it straight to covers.
Rumman Raees is back on.
Misses the yorker mark and slips a low full toss, Upul sends it to long on and keeps strike with himself. 54 needed off 36 balls.
Hits the blockhole, Tharanga tries to dig it out and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Spears in a full ball on off, Vandersay squeezes it out past the bowler towards long on and takes a single.
Short in length and outside off, Vandersay plays a controlled pull shot but finds the short mid-wicket fielder.
Angling into the batsman, Vandersay tries to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge past the point fielder for a couple.
Funny! A length ball on off, Vandersay gets across to defend but misses and the ball gets stuck in the flap of his right pad. Hasan runs up to collect it from there and then smiles.
Googly on middle, it's punched down to long on for a single. 9 from the over!
Flighted ball on middle, helped in front of square leg for a run. On 95!
Short in length and outside off, cut with the spin to deep point for a single.
A flipper on middle, Vandersay goes back and defends it towards the bowler. Shadab is wiping the ball after almost every delivery. Dew has set in and gripping is a problem.
Flatter and on middle, quietly nudged behind square leg for a single.
Wide! Sharp spin down the leg side, Tharanga leaves it and Sarfraz only manages to deflect it towards short fine leg.
FOUR! Wow, a lovely shot! A loopy full ball on middle, Tharanga clears his front leg and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery on off, Vandersay is on his toes as he defends it to the leg side.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Upul works it in the gap on the leg side and wants a couple. Has to settle with a run only this time.
Ali switches to around the wicket and angles in a full ball on middle, Tharanga flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fine leg comes up, point drops back and there is third man in place too.
Straighter in line, helped towards mid-wicket for a single. 150 up for Sri Lanka.
Drops it on a length again, outside off, Vandersay pushes it back.
On a length and outside off, hit from the back foot to point.
Hasan Ali is back on.
A googly around off, Vandersay knocks it down to long on for a single. He is playing his part in this partnership. 12 from the over.
Quicker full ball on the pads, eased past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Flatter and on off, punched to sweeper cover for a couple of runs. All of a sudden, Pakistan are found wanting in the field. Momentum shift?
FOUR! Tharanga is motoring now! Floated full ball outside off, Upul latches onto it and powers it over covers for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up, really frustrating for Pakistan!
FOUR! Shot! Shadab drifts on the pads, full and turning down, Tharanga kneels and slogs it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Loopy leg spinner landing just outside leg, spinning back in. Tharanga still manages to create room by going deep inside the crease but hits it straight to point.

Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Which means a maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the game. 83 needed for Sri Lanka to win this game in 60 balls. Upul Tharanga is the key to this game for the visitors. We're in for a good last phase.
Good length delivery outside off, pushed to mid off for a quick single.
Straighter in line, turned in front of square leg for a single.

Run out chance missed! Cutting back into the batsman from around off, Tharanga taps it down to short third man and sets off for a single. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end otherwise Vandersay would have been a goner.
Angles in a length ball on off, Tharanga tickles it through mid-wicket and runs the first run hard. Wants the second and completes it in the end. Sarfraz is screaming in anger.
Clever delivery, a cutter jagging back in, Tharanga tries to be cute. Attempts to run it down to third man but misses.
FOUR! Poor delivery and it has been put away. Short and wide outside off, Tharanga exercises his arms and slaps it over covers for a boundary.
Serves a wrong 'un on middle, Vandersay gets deep inside the crease and punches it to cover-point.
Loopy full ball on off, Upul knocks it down to long on and collects a single.
Short and on middle, Tharanga moves deep inside the crease and cuts it square of the wicket. Finds point.
Full toss on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Flatter and on middle, Vandersay goes back and punches it to mid-wicket.
Hits a full ball with the spin to covers. Dot ball.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Tharanga tries to work it on the leg side but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.

FOUR! Tharanga continues to fight... The delivery is full around off, Upul stays rooted to the crease and lifts it over covers. No one in the deep and it's a boundary. Sarfraz gives a stare to his bowler, not looking too happy.
Sees the batsman making space by moving leg side and bowls it full and wide outside off. Tharanga leaves it and Raees is lucky that it's not wided. Was very close to the tramline.
Good length delivery outside off, Tharanga rocks back and punches it down to mid off.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
A touch short in length and outside off, Tharanga delays his shot and guides it to third man for a single.
Rumman Raees is back on.
Quicker one on middle, worked to mid-wicket. Maiden!

Huge shout for a catch! Not given. A leg spinner curling away from the batsman, Vandersay tries playing an expansive cover drive but fails to connect. Sarfraz, however, jumps in celebration after collecting the ball. Shadab also joins him but the umpire remains unmoved. No reviews left for Pakistan. Snicko detects something. Hmm...
Googly this time, on middle and spinning down, Vandersay tries to flick but misses.
Loopy and full on off, drawing the batsman forward, Vandersay tries driving but is beaten by the away spin.
A touch short and on off, turning away, Vandersay cuts but finds the point fielder.
Spinning big away from the batsman, Vandersay flashes and misses.
A pacey bouncer this time, 140 kph and well-directed, Tharanga immediately sits down to let it through. 100 needed off 84 balls!
An off pace delivery, short and outside off, 126 kph, Tharanga senses the trap and leaves it alone.
Digs in a short ball on leg, Jeffrey pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball on off, Vandersay is just about managing to hold forte. Keeps it out safely on the leg side.
Hits the blockhole, a heavy ball by Ali, Vandersay does well to dig it out.
Speeds in from around the wicket and darts in a fuller length ball on middle, Tharanga flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Too full in length on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball outside off, Vandersay slices his drive through backward point for a couple of runs.
A leg spinner this time, around off, Vandersay pushes at it and misses. Just toying with the batsman, Shadab.
Googly around off, Jeffrey picks it at the last moment and somehow keeps it out on the leg side.

Spinning down the leg side, Tharanga tries working it across the line but fails to make proper connection. Sarfraz fails to collect it and they cross. Given as a run. That should be a dropped chance then. Another life for Upul.
Shadab Khan is back on. An over back, Mickey Arthur was seen not too happy as he wanted the leg spinner to continue. His message is conveyed now as Sarfraz makes the change.
A rising delivery, sharp in pace, Vandersay gets hurried up as he fends it off on the leg side.
Slower delivery, a touch short and on middle, Upul helps it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Plays it off his pads to the leg side but not in the gap.

Nearly a stunner by Shehzad! Short in length and on off, Vandersay pulls it in the air over square leg. Not timed it properly. Shehzad runs in from the deep, dives forward but fails to grab it. A single.
Good length ball shaping back into the batsman from around off, Vandersay gets a bit forward and defends it to mid-wicket.
Bang! Once again Tharanga fetches a short ball from outside off and pulls it powerfully to the right of deep mid-wicket. A couple of runs to end the over, 9 from it.
Slower bouncer outside off, Tharanga tries playing the upper cut but is deceived by the slowness of the ball.
Lands it on a length around off, Vandersay stays back to defend but gets an inside edge past his legs to square leg. A single taken.
Too full in length and outside off, driven down the ground to mid off where the fielder dived but failed to make a clean stop. They ran a run.
FOUR! Is this the indication that Tharanga will shift gears? Short in length and outside off, Upul stays back, fetches it well and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length delivery in the line of the stumps, Vandersay moves across and works it through square leg for a single.
Junaid Khan is back in action. He has got a slip to support him.

Drinks break. Sri Lanka are staring down the barrel now after a terrible collapse. With only three wickets left, their last hope will be skipper Upul Tharanga. 116 needed off 108 balls. Pakistan have the momentum at the moment and their spinners are calling the shots, especially Shadab Khan. 2-0 seems probable.
Aahhh...loses patience this time. Hasan goes short again, around leg, Tharanga tries pulling but fails to make any sort of connection.
Short in length around middle and off, Tharanga sticks back, shapes up for the little dab but then restrains himself from doing so.
That's a good shot. Full in length and outside off, it's driven square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball, Vandersay sits underneath it and it's called a wide for height.
Fullish and on off, flicked on the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, angling in, Vandersay stays back to defend it to the cover region.
Shortish length ball outside off, Vandersay stays back to hit through the line but mistimes it to the off side.
Hasan Ali is brought back on.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Plays it with the spin to mid-wicket and takes a run.
FOUR! 35th ODI fifty for the skipper! Takes the calculative risk, knows mid off is up and goes over the fielder to collect a boundary. He is Sri Lanka's last hope.

Shout for an lbw! A leg spinner landing on middle, Tharanga fails to work it around and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Maybe, turning too much? No, the replays show it to be hitting the leg stump. Another life for the Lankan skipper.
Goes on the back foot and punches it through cover-point for a single.

Spinning back into the batsman from around middle, Vandersay goes back and eases it behind square leg for a single. End of a terrific spell by Hafeez, 10-0-24-1! He was awesome in the last game too, adding variety to Pakistan's attack with his all-round prowess.
Loopy and full outside off, Vandersay drives it off his front foot to cover-point.
Works it with the spin, behind square leg but the leg gully fielder quickly gets to the ball. No run taken.
Gets forward to a full ball and defends it back.
Flatter and on off, punched from the crease but once again straight to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, Vandersay gets forward and helps it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Loopy leg spinner on off, Tharanga draws forward and defends it back to the bowler. Another impressive over by Shadab!
Quicker and fuller on off, pushed towards mid off for a sharp single.
Floated full ball on off, driven off the front foot to extra cover. A good diving stop inside the ring. Dot ball.
A flighted leg spinner outside off, Vandersay flashes and misses. Beaten by spin.
Gives it good flight and hits the yorker mark, Vandersay digs it out.
Jeffrey Vandersay is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Timber! Shadab is on fire. He is up and running in celebration. A leg spinner landing around off, Akila rather than getting forward stays back to keep it out but is beaten by the inward spin. It goes right through to disturb the stumps. Sri Lanka reeling now, what a collapse this has been!
Tharanga has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Tidy over, 2 runs and a wicket from it!
Turning away from the batsman, Tharanga plays the drive but finds the point fielder.
Works a quicker delivery on the leg side but finds the fielder.
Skidding into the batsman, Dananjaya flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Akila Dananjaya is the next batsman in.

OUT! Babar Azam has managed to somehow hold on to the catch! Hafeez has his first wicket and he gets it with an off spinner. Pitches it full around off, Perera is forward to attempt a drive but it takes the outside edge and goes down low to first slip. Azam takes his hands down but fluffs it in the first attempt. But then he manages to keep it under his grasp by sticking it to his body. They appeal for the catch, Babar is confident but the umpires want to get it checked. They however have given it out as the soft signal. The replays confirm that it's a clean catch and the dangerous Thisara has to depart. Body blow to Sri Lanka.
Babar Azam has taken a low catch at first slip. He is claiming it but the batsman is not going anywhere. The umpires get together and take it upstairs. The soft signal is out.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Flighted and on off, defended from the back foot. 8 runs and a wicket from the over!
FOUR! Bang! Too full in length and outside off, Perera goes against the turn but makes sure to back it up with enough power. He smacks it through extra cover and sends it across the rope.
Spinning down leg, Tharanga nudges wide of short fine leg and crosses.
Too full and outside off, Thisara drills it through covers and takes three runs.
Gets forward to a fuller length ball and defends it back.
Thisara Perera arrives. 137 needed off 143 balls.

OUT! Shadab strikes again! He was held back by Sarfraz when two southpaws were batting earlier in the innings but not this time. And the leggie proves that he is equally effective against any type of batter. It's a googly around off, turning the other way, not sure Milinda picked it. He goes back to punch through the line but it takes the outside edge and Babar Azam makes no mistake at first slip this time. Pakistan keeping themselves in the hunt!
Darts it in, around off, Tharanga defends it back.
Hafeez keeps firing it in, not intending to make the ball turn. It's going through with the angle and Tharanga defends it back from the inner half of the bat.
Fires it in on off, it's punched to sweeper cover for one.
Nearly a return catch! This one stops a bit onto the batsman, around middle, Siriwardana checks his shot and chips back aerially. Doesn't carry back to the bowler.
Another flatter delivery, full and on middle, flicked through the gap at mid-wicket for a brace. Good running between the wickets!
Quicker full ball on off, Tharanga gets back to defend, has no idea that the ball is skidding back into him. It takes the inside edge and goes through his legs to square leg for a single.
Spinning in from outside off, Milinda nudges it to mid-wicket.
Milinda Siriwardana is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Shadab is up and running. That is a leg spinner's delight. Slips in the wrong one around off, Chandimal does not read it and goes for a booming drive but misses it completely to get his stumps rattled. Another failure for Dinesh. Sri Lanka in a spot of bother now.
Eases this one to long off for a single.
FOUR! Handy boundary! The poor deliveries need to be put away like this. Short outside off, Tharanga rocks back and cuts it past backward point to pick up another boundary.
Tharanga plays this one with the spin to mid-wicket.
Outside off, spinning in and stays low. Tharanga hangs back and keeps it out.
Shadab Khan is into the attack. A right-hander is at the crease and Sarfraz immediately brings him in for a bowl.
Short delivery on off, helped to the man at square leg.
Hafeez once again stops in his delivery stride. He's having trouble while planting his landing foot just before releasing the ball. Strange, shouldn't happen given he's a spinner.
Fullish delivery, clipped to short mid-wicket.
Long off comes inside the ring.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Tossed up delivery, eased back towards the bowler.
Wide! Down the leg side, Upul aims to clip it away but misses.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Clips this one down the leg side for a couple.
Dinesh Chandimal strides out to bat.

OUT! The decision stands! Coming in with the arm, Thirimanne kneels and goes for the big slog sweep but misses to get hit flush on the back pad. The Pakistanis roar in appeal and the umpire decides to rule it out. Lahiru goes for the review. Time for the replays. The Snicko doesn't spot any edge. Hawk Eye rolls in. It is pitching in line, the impact is in line and it is clipping the leg stump. A dodgy knock from Thirimanne comes to an end. However, Sri Lanka do not lose a review.
Thirimanne opts to take a review against an LBW decision. Looks adjacent to the naked eye.
Outside off, Lahiru looks to dab it past the keeper but fails to connect.
Well played! Floated outside off, Tharanga lifts it over extra cover to rotate strike.
Fired in on off, Upul makes room and chops it to the man at point.
Stays back to the quicker delivery and blocks it.
Nervy moment! Sliding in with the angle, Lahiru hangs back and cuts it to point. Had he missed that, it would have crashed into the stumps.
Flighted delivery outside off, Lahiru eases it towards wide mid off. The fielder at short extra cover dives full length to his left to stop it.
Flatter one outside off, Tharanga waits for it and dabs it past the keeper to third man. Three runs taken.
Fraction short around off, Tharanga rocks back and cracks it straight to the man at point.
Wide! Slipped down the leg side, Upul fails to flick it away.
Shortish delivery outside off, Lahiru strokes it to covers for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Half-tracker outside off, Tharanga makes good use of the depth of the crease and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket to find the fence. The umpires check whether it's hit the boundary cushions on the full or not. It just bounced within the ropes.

Not out! Successful review! Pushed quicker through the air outside off, a bit shorter in length. Tharanga aims to dab it to third man but seems to have missed it. Malik appeals vociferously and the umpire after a thought rules it out. However, Tharanga is absolutely confident that there is no wood involved. It is taken upstairs. Time for the Snickometer. There is a spike but that is because the bat hit the back pad. The skipper will carry on.
Review for a caught behind against Upul Tharanga. The Lankan skipper has taken the review immediately, which can only mean he's dead sure there's no edge. Over to the third umpire...
Around off, staying a bit low. Tharanga rocks back and taps it to backward point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! A boundary after almost 8 overs! Brilliantly executed shot. Floated outside off, Tharanga goes inside out over extra cover. Beats the man in the deep with ease to pick up a boundary.
Living dangerously at the moment! Coming in with the arm, Thirimanne exposes his stumps and cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
In the air... but safe! Short delivery, skidding in. Thirimanne goes for a pull but miscues it towards long on. It falls well short of the fielder. A single taken.
Plays this with an angled blade to point.
Good use of the feet from the skipper. Places this to the same region to rotate strike. That is what Sri Lanka need to do on a consistent basis. There have been too many dot balls.
Lahiru advances down the track to the floated delivery and eases it to sweeper cover for a run.
Makes room to the shortish delivery and cuts it to covers.
Two leg byes! Outside leg stump, Tharanga kneels to sweep it hard but misses. It beats the keeper as well. Two leg byes signaled by the umpire. Must have come from the pads.
Slider this time at a quicker pace, Tharanga is beaten for pace and is hit on the pads. A chirpy appeal is turned down. That was clearly going down leg.
Sliding down the leg side, Upul fails to connect and the ball brushes his pads to roll to short fine leg.
Spinning away from Upul. He pushes at it and gets it off the outer half towards the slip fielder.
Leans forward to the tossed up delivery and defends it confidently.
Plays this one with soft hands to covers for a brisk run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Drifting down the leg side, Tharanga flicks it to the man at short fine leg and sets off for a run. The throw is at the non-striker's end but the skipper makes his ground. Sarfraz is not happy, he wanted the throw to come to him.
Floated delivery, pushed back towards the bowler.
Darted in line of the stumps, Upul makes room and taps it to cover-point. Dangerous to play that way, exposing all your stumps.
Full delivery outside off, sliced with the spin to backward point.
Tossed up on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
Drinks break!
Fired in on the leg stump, Thirimanne aims to flick it away but is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal for an LBW is turned down. That was sliding down leg.
Around off, spinning away. Tharanga cuts it off the outer half towards third man. Shadab from point hares after it and slides near the fence to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.

Dropped! The skipper should thank his stars. He is leading a charmed life. Fullish delivery outside off, Tharanga goes for an expansive drive but gets a thick outside edge. It comes at a nice height to Babar Azam at first slip who fails to latch onto it. He is staring down at the ground in disappointment. You can't afford to drop catches when you are defending such a moderate total.
On the pads, clipped to mid-wicket. Lahiru wants the run but he is rightly sent back by the skipper.
Makes room for himself and pats it back to the bowler.
Drifting in towards the pads, helped to the leg side for an easy run.
Shoaib Malik to roll his arm over now.
Around off, Thirimanne places it towards point and takes off. His partner responds. There is a throw at the bowler's end but Lahiru beats it with ease.
Turn and bounce! Floated on middle, spinning away sharply. Lahiru is surprised a touch but does well to block it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Beaten! Pushed quicker through the air outside off, skids through the surface. Thirimanne aims to cut it behind point but misses it completely.
Fullish this time, Thirimanne lunges forward in defense.
Uses his feet and drives it straight to the man at short cover.
Around the hips, tucked around the corner for a run.
Fullish delivery, angling in. Lahiru covers the line and defends it stoutly.
Wide! Tries to tuck Thirimanne up with a shortish delivery but this is down the leg side. The batsman misses his tuck.
Short delivery, bowled at sharp pace. Lahiru sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it.
Length delivery outside off, glided down to third man for a run.

Length delivery outside off, Tharanga goes for an ambitious drive but is beaten all ends up. The skipper needs to keep his calm. This is a tough passage of play for the Lankans and he needs to take up the responsibility to guide his side through it.
Ali steams in from around the wicket and bowls it on off. Tharanga backs away and only manages to push it to Ali who throws it back to the keeper. He has a wry smile on his face.
Leans ahead confidently to the floated delivery and blocks it. Pakistan building good pressure here.
Helps this one with the angle around the corner to rotate strike.
Flighted ball, eased back to the bowler.
Hangs deep in the crease to place it to backward point for a run.
A fraction short, Lahiru backs away and cuts it to point.
Thirimanne backs away and taps this one to covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. Another good over from Ali.

FOUR! Weird shot! That could have landed the skipper in a lot of trouble. Back of a length around off, Tharanga keeps his bat skywards and tries to leave it. However, the ball hits the back of his bat. Deflects to short fine leg and races to the fence.
Ali goes around the wicket and angles this one in. Tharanga eases it to covers.
On a length outside off, staying low. Lahiru does well to glide it to third man for a run.
Around the hips, Lahiru works it to mid-wicket.
Stays back to the length delivery and dabs it with the angle to wide slip.

Edged! A lot happening at the moment! Tossed up around off, Thirimanne tries to defend it off his front foot but gets an outside edge that falls in front of first slip and goes past him. A run taken. End of an eventful first over from Hafeez.
Helps this with the angle to the leg side.
Fraction short, punched through covers for a run.

DROPPED! What have you done, Shadab? Floated around off, Tharanga uses his feet but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Ends up chipping it towards Khan at short extra cover. He hurries a bit and ends up dropping a sitter. How costly will that prove?
Slow through the air, Tharanga looks to clip it away but gets a soft leading edge down the track.
Tossed up delivery, pushed back towards the bowler.
Mohammad Hafeez to bowl.
Good length delivery on off, Thirimanne defends it out. Brings an end to a successful over from Hasan Ali.
Lahiru Thirimanne walks into the middle next.

OUT! Mendis is gone and his poor run continues! Hasan Ali provides his side with the breakthrough, like he's doing so often nowadays. Pounds in another short ball and this time Mendis decides to take the pull shot on. Is not in control of the shot at all and gets a big top edge over square leg. Ahmed Shehzad out in the deep runs in and takes a safe catch. Sri Lanka lose their second.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another bouncer and once again Mendis ducks and evades.
Brings out the short ball and bangs the deck hard, Mendis ducks and evades.
Touch shorter in length, outside off, stays back and pushes it away on the off side.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders will now be allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Fuller and flatter outside off, Tharanga looks to cut but the ball goes off the outside edge and behind the keeper, going off his pads.
Sliding in on the pads, Mendis with a flick this time through square leg for a run.
Spinning in from around off, Upul goes deep inside the crease and turns it square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller and quicker, attacking the stumps, guarded out well from the front foot.
From over the wicket now, flatter and shorter outside off, dabbed to point from within the crease.
Slider on off, worked through mid on for an easy run.
Imad Wasim to bowl.
Good length ball around off, Tharanga plays at it and gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Straighter in line once again, worked away on the leg side, straight to mid-wicket again.
Fraction straight in line, flicked away straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Doesn't bounce as much as it's bowled on a length, Upul is solid in defense.

NOT OUT! Pakistan waste their only review! It was evident to the naked eye clearly, taking the review was a bad call. Hasan Ali bowls a length ball which catches Tharanga on the pads. Roaring appeal which the umpire shuts down instantly. The bowler asks his skipper to take the review and replays show that the ball pitched outside leg which puts the argument to bed.
Sarfraz Ahmed decides to take a review against an LBW decision. Upul Tharanga is the man in question. Seems like it pitched outside leg. Let's find out...
Good length delivery sliding on, Tharanga manages to bring his bat down in time. It kept a little low and he did well to block.
First bowling change for the Men in Green. Hasan Ali is on to bowl.
Bit short in length, Mendis stands tall and defends it well off the back foot.
Back of a length coming back into the body, worked away through the gap on the leg side for a couple of good runs. Found the gap well behind square leg, lot of space out there.
Back of a length, hangs back and drops it down on the off side with soft hands.
Skidding length delivery around off, Mendis plays it late as he stabs it to point.

FOUR! Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result! This is good batting by Kusal Mendis. He sees the ball pitched up, has picked his spot and just lofts it over wide mid on. Sends it across the rope and gets a boundary to his name.
Lands it on a length on off, it skids a bit as Mendis does well to adjust and defend. Could have been bowled, did well to keep it out.
Another one on the fuller side, pushed back down the ground for nothing.
Full delivery outside off, driven to mid off. He's middling it better now, which is a good sign for him and his team.
Back of a length delivery around the off stick, tapped down in front of covers from within the crease.
Hasan Ali is warming up.

One more lbw appeal, once again turned down! Junaid Khan with a length ball which Kusal Mendis flicks away on the leg side. The appeal is useless for two reasons - firstly because it pitched outside leg and secondly, because Mendis got some bat on it. A single is taken.
Coming back in on middle and leg, worked on the on side with soft hands.
Just ahead of a length and angling across, blocked well by taking a stride forward.
Stays back to this back of a length delivery and sees the over out with ease.
Length delivery around off, Tharanga defends it out from within his crease.

RIPPER, ABSOLUTE RIPPER! Perfect delivery from Rumman Raees. Comes steaming in and lands it on a length around off. It moves away late and almost takes the edge of Upul Tharanga's hanging bat. So, so close. He couldn't do anything about it.
On the fourth stump line, the Lankan skipper is tentative at first. Wants to play it but then lets it be at the last moment.

Another stifled shout, but this time height's the issue. Back of a length jagging back in on middle and off, catches Tharanga high on the thigh pads and that's evident for everyone to see. Pakistan pull out of the appeal almost immediately.

Moderate lbw shouts, turned down by the umpire! Angling into the batsman, Tharanga misses his flick and is rapped on the pads. There's an appeal made, but nothing from the umpire. Raees quickly pulls out of it too as he realizes the ball is angling too far down leg.
Fires it full on middle and leg, Mendis gets right behind the line before defending it in front of short mid-wicket.
Nice, tight line. Landed on a length on off, it skids off the surface a bit. Mendis meets it with a solid, straight blade as he blocks it in front of covers.
Slants it across wide outside off, keeps a tad low too which makes Mendis miss. He slashes and it goes under his bat to the keeper on the bounce.
Length delivery well outside off, the southpaw waits for it and cuts it late down to third man. Picks up a run for doing so.
Goes full again, bowls it around off, Upul Tharanga works it off the inner half to the mid-wicket fielder.
Sprays it on the pads, Mendis comfortably tucks it down to fine leg for one.
Short of a good length around off, punched away into the off side from the back foot. An eventful over comes to an end.

FOUR! SUBLIME! Always such a treat to watch. He'll feel much more confident after that. Full and outside off, Tharanga just sweetly drives this through the gap in the covers and finds the fence with ease.

FOUR! EDGED AND IT'S THROUGH! Dear, oh dear... The slip was wide and as a result, the Lankan skipper has survived. Length delivery with room on offer outside off, Tharanga goes after it and gets a thick edge. Flies right through the gap between the keeper and the wide slip man and away to the third man fence.
Another drive this time but it's down the ground. Tharanga meets the full ball with the full face of the bat and finds mid off.
Clever slower delivery from Raees, he bowls it full and outside off, Tharanga picks it up and drives it square to backward point.
Full and swinging away a shade on off, Tharanga with a tame drive which finds the man at mid on.
Length delivery on off, Kusal Mendis ends the over with a successful defensive shot.
Touch short this time, still pretty close to the off stump line, solidly blocked in front of covers.
Lands it on a good length again, close to off, Mendis once again keeps it out watchfully.
Good length delivery around off, seaming away off the deck, Kusal Mendis is squared up a bit as he defends it down on the track from within his crease.
Kusal Mendis strides out at No. 3. Can the youngster put his hand up and accept the challenge?

OUT! DICKWELLA IS GONE! Huge wicket for Pakistan, he's just the man they wanted. Junaid Khan with an absolute beauty as he swings this one back in from outside off, it keeps a little low too and this does Dickwella in. He swings hard across the line, only for the ball to sneak under the bat and strike him on the pads. He's caught flush in front of the stumps and the umpire has no trouble to raise his finger. The hosts are pumped.
Length ball which keeps a little low, Upul gets an inside edge as he looks to force it on the off side. Single taken as the ball rolls away towards fine leg.
Late away movement squares up Upul Tharanga. It's on a length and he gets it off the outer half down to third man as he pushes at it. Single taken.
Short of a good length on the fifth stump line, pushed out well off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed wide of the point fielder for an easy single.

Full and swinging away outside off, Dickwella drives and drives well. Looks to pierce the gap through the covers but a diving effort from the fielder there stops runs. That's a packed off side, going to take something special for runs to come in/through that area.

Excellent line! On a good length in the off stump channel, a hint of away movement as Dickwella leaves it alone. This is good bowling from Raees, going to be a challenge for Niroshan to not tempt himself to playing these.

Probing delivery first up from Rumman Raees! He bowls it on a length just around off, Dickwella has to play at it and he does. Gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball falls down right beside him.
Rumman Raees will bowl with the second new ball from the other end. A wide slip in place.
A touch fuller in length, swinging in from outside off. Tharanga looks to push it through covers but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Similar length ball outside off, steered to third man for a run.

Appeal for an lbw! Good length delivery around off, Tharanga looks to block it off his back foot but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls to point. Shadab has a shy at the bowler's end which misses otherwise Niroshan would have got into a spot of bother. The replays confirm that there was an inside edge.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.

Four leg byes! Bad start from Junaid! Slips this one down the leg side, Tharanga tries to clip it away but the ball brushes his pads and flies past the diving Sarfraz. Rolls through to the fine leg fence.
Off the mark straightaway! Length delivery around off, Dickwella eases it past point for a run.

Welcome back for the chase. The men who matter are out in the middle. The floodlights are in full effect at the stadium. Niroshan Dickwella and Upul Tharanga to open the batting for Sri Lanka. Junaid Khan to steam in with the first new ball. A wide slip and a gully in place.
